summary: Assist to Saguache County in 3-day search for a missing 29-year-old woman on Kit Carson Peak; subject recovered deceased on Day 3 (Oct 12-15)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Saguache County SAR
notes: ART missions 2021-114, 2021-115, 2021-116. | Run-131 merge: Alamosa Citizen Daily Report (opened) names the subject as Madeline Baharlou-Quivey, 29, a Denver nurse at Presbyterian St. Luke's Medical Center; she texted Monday Oct 11 that she was cliffed out; Tuesday ground crews pulled out due to high wind/snow; Wednesday aerial crews identified her body (fall) but worsening weather aborted recovery; the Saturday recovery used technical rope rigging in Class 5 terrain near "The Avenue" descent with Cañon Helitack support, completed ~1 a.m. Sunday; responding agencies: Saguache County SAR, AVSAR, Western Mountain Rescue, CCSAR, Chaffee County SAR, Alpine Rescue Team, Colorado National Guard, DFPC Cañon Helitack. AVSAR's own mission log (opened run 597) confirms the multi-day timeline: search began 2021-10-12, body found 2021-10-13, technical recovery 2021-10-16; multi-agency with Saguache County SAR, Western Mountain Rescue, Canon City Helitack.
